verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer runs client-facing platforms such as GDHQ, which holds corporate records, and the Contract Generator, so asking about data portability is fair. However, the evidence only says GDHQ gives 'easy access' to records. Nothing documents bulk export, open formats or offboarding portability, and the ChatGD and Catalyze items are unrelated to export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
